# The Pennsylvania State University | Penn State

> Penn State is a leading public research university offering undergraduate, graduate, professional, and online education across campuses in Pennsylvania and worldwide.

Penn State serves students through residential campuses, Penn State World Campus, major research institutes, libraries, student services, and professional schools. Its web presence spans admissions, academic programs, research, student life, registrar and bursar services, and specialized units including medicine, law, and global engagement.

## University Overview
- [Penn State Home](https://www.psu.edu/): Main university homepage with institutional overview, academics, research, and campus information.
- [About Penn State](https://www.psu.edu/about): Overview of Penn State’s mission, campuses, leadership, and institutional profile.
- [Campuses and Colleges](https://www.psu.edu/campuses): Directory of Penn State campuses and locations across Pennsylvania.
- [Academics](https://www.psu.edu/academics): Entry point for degree programs, colleges, and academic opportunities.
- [Research](https://www.psu.edu/research): Overview of Penn State research strengths, institutes, and innovation activity.
- [News](https://www.psu.edu/news): University news, announcements, research stories, and campus updates.
- [Events](https://www.psu.edu/events): University-wide calendar of public events, lectures, and activities.

## Admissions and Enrollment
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://admissions.psu.edu/): Undergraduate admissions information, application steps, deadlines, and visit opportunities.
- [Apply to Penn State](https://admissions.psu.edu/apply/): Application options, requirements, and next steps for prospective undergraduates.
- [Visit Penn State](https://admissions.psu.edu/visit/): Campus visit programs, tours, and admissions events for prospective students.
- [Tuition and Costs](https://admissions.psu.edu/costs-aid/): Undergraduate tuition, estimated costs, and financial aid overview.
- [Graduate Admissions](https://gradschool.psu.edu/admissions/): Graduate application guidance, requirements, and admissions policies.
- [How to Apply to Graduate School](https://gradschool.psu.edu/admissions/how-to-apply/): Step-by-step graduate application process and required materials.
- [Penn State World Campus Admissions](https://www.worldcampus.psu.edu/admissions): Admissions information for online degree and certificate students.

## Academics and Degree Programs
- [Undergraduate Bulletin](https://bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/): Official undergraduate programs, degree requirements, and academic policies.
- [Graduate Bulletin](https://bulletins.psu.edu/graduate/): Official graduate programs, requirements, and academic policies.
- [Penn State Majors](https://admissions.psu.edu/academics/majors/): Searchable list of undergraduate majors and program descriptions.
- [Colleges and Schools](https://www.psu.edu/academics/colleges): Directory of Penn State academic colleges and schools.
- [Academic Programs at World Campus](https://www.worldcampus.psu.edu/degrees-and-certificates): Online degree and certificate offerings across disciplines.
- [University Course Descriptions](https://bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/): Catalog of official course descriptions across Penn State.
- [Academic Advising](https://advising.psu.edu/): Advising resources, planning tools, and student academic support information.

## Registrar, Calendars, and Student Records
- [Office of the University Registrar](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/): Registrar services including registration, records, transcripts, and academic calendars.
- [Academic Calendars](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/academic-calendars/): Semester calendars with important dates, deadlines, and breaks.
- [Registration Information](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/registration/): Registration policies, enrollment dates, and course scheduling guidance.
- [Transcripts](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/transcripts/): Official and unofficial transcript ordering and delivery information.
- [Graduation](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/graduation/): Graduation application procedures, deadlines, and diploma information.
- [Enrollment Verification](https://www.registrar.psu.edu/enrollment-verification/): Verification services for enrollment status and degree completion.

## Tuition, Billing, and Financial Aid
- [Office of the Bursar](https://www.bursar.psu.edu/): Billing, payment, tuition, and student account management services.
- [Tuition Information](https://www.bursar.psu.edu/tuition): Tuition rates and related student cost information.
- [Student Aid](https://studentaid.psu.edu/): Financial aid, scholarships, loans, and aid application guidance.
- [Types of Aid](https://studentaid.psu.edu/types-of-aid): Overview of grants, scholarships, loans, and work-study options.
- [FAFSA and Applying for Aid](https://studentaid.psu.edu/apply-for-aid): Financial aid application steps, deadlines, and required forms.
- [Payment Options](https://www.bursar.psu.edu/payment-options): Available methods for paying tuition and student account balances.

- [LiveOn](https://liveon.psu.edu/): On-campus housing, residence life, dining, and move-in information.
- [Penn State Housing](https://liveon.psu.edu/university-park/housing): Housing options, room types, and residential information for students.
- [Campus Recreation](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/campusrec): Recreation facilities, fitness programs, and intramural sports information.
- [Health and Wellness](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/health-wellness): Student health, counseling, and wellness support resources.
- [Career Services](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/career): Career counseling, internships, and job search support for students.
- [Student Organizations](https://studentaffairs.psu.edu/studentorgs): Student clubs, leadership opportunities, and involvement resources.

## Libraries, Research, and Innovation

- [Office of the Senior Vice President for Research](https://research.psu.edu/): Research administration, funding, compliance, and support services.
- [Undergraduate Research](https://undergradresearch.psu.edu/): Opportunities, programs, and guidance for student research participation.
- [Invent Penn State](https://invent.psu.edu/): Entrepreneurship, innovation, startups, and commercialization resources.

## Online, Global, and Continuing Education
- [Penn State World Campus](https://www.worldcampus.psu.edu/): Penn State’s online campus for degrees, certificates, and lifelong learning.
- [World Campus Degrees and Certificates](https://www.worldcampus.psu.edu/degrees-and-certificates): Browse online academic programs by level and subject.
- [Penn State Global](https://global.psu.edu/): International programs, partnerships, and global engagement initiatives.
- [Education Abroad](https://global.psu.edu/education-abroad): Study abroad programs, advising, and international learning opportunities.
- [International Students](https://global.psu.edu/international-students-scholars): Immigration, advising, and support resources for international students and scholars.
- [Continuing Education](https://www.outreach.psu.edu/): Professional development, youth programs, and continuing education offerings.

## Graduate and Professional Education

- [Graduate Programs](https://gradschool.psu.edu/graduate-programs/): Directory of graduate degrees and academic program offerings.
- [Penn State Dickinson Law](https://dickinsonlaw.psu.edu/): Law school academics, admissions, and student resources.
- [Penn State Law](https://pennstatelaw.psu.edu/): Legal education programs, admissions, and academic information.
- [College of Medicine](https://med.psu.edu/): Medical education, research, patient care, and academic programs.
- [College of Medicine Education](https://med.psu.edu/education): MD, PA, graduate, and continuing medical education programs.
- [Smeal College of Business](https://www.smeal.psu.edu/): Business degree programs, research, and executive education resources.
